results.content: For nearly two years, Taylor Swift spent almost all of her weekends putting on a grueling three-and-a-half-hour show for the Eras Tour. When Swift appeared on the "New Heights" podcast in August 2025, her now-brother-in-law Jason Kelce asked her if she missed being out on the road. Swift acknowledged that while she occasionally reminisced on those days, they were extremely physically demanding for her. [...] During a December 2025 appearance on "The Late Show with Stephen Colbert," Taylor Swift shared that she had been down with the stomach flu "multiple" times during the Eras Tour.
